bullets.title: My NFT project, “Project 555.”
bullets.note:
“Project 555” is the codename for my upcoming NFT project. It’s going to be highly stylized and unlike anything I’ve ever done. I started buying BTC in 2012–2013, I began collecting NFTs in early 2021, I quietly launched [my first stand-alone NFT](http://tim.blog/nft) (also my first published fiction) in February 2022 with [PROOF/Kevin Rose](https://twitter.com/kevinrose), and this will be my first in-depth NFT project. It’s going to be very elaborate and unbelievably bizarre.  
​  
​**100% of primary sale proceeds will go to the** [**Saisei Foundation**](https://saiseifoundation.org/)**.** The Saisei Foundation is a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit private foundation that funds cutting-edge scientific research and other initiatives related to psychedelic medicine, mental health therapeutics, life-extension technologies, ecosystem conservation, indigenous knowledge preservation, and more.  
​  
If you’re a trader who expects free money by yelling on the Internet when you’re unhappy, please do not participate in this project. In fact, if you’re a dick online at all, please sit this one out. There are plenty of other NFT projects that will promise the moon, and you can harass them. I promise nothing other than (1) good art (IMHO), (2) perhaps some entertainment and a few laughs along the way, and (3) aiming to do some good with the Saisei Foundation. That’s it.  
​  
​[**Click here for more NFT details**](https://www.premint.xyz/tim/)**. This link is exclusively for** _**5-Bullet Friday**_ **subscribers.**

bullets.title: Isle of Dogs
bullets.note: ([Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B08GSL7VGT/), [Apple TV](https://itunes.apple.com/us/movie/isle-of-dogs/id1363298490), [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KeUx7tk1kdM), [Disney+](https://www.disneyplus.com/movies/isle-of-dogs/3Ypmb1WnRXCH)). The “critics consensus” [from Rotten Tomatoes](https://www.rottentomatoes.com/m/isle_of_dogs_2018), where the film has a 90% approval rating: “The beautifully stop-motion animated _Isle of Dogs_ finds [Wes Anderson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wes_Anderson) at his detail-oriented best while telling one of the director’s most winsomely charming stories.” Watch the trailer [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dt__kig8PVU). Thanks to Cristina for the wonderful recommendation. A little bird told me this film is especially hilarious on edibles with 5–10mg of THC. I challenge you to watch the trailer and dispute this.
